protocol.scope: Current model families refitted before each deadline, full chip-window planning with current selection guards; identical random seed and per-MIP main-search allowance. limitations: Current season is a diagnostic, not an untouched promotion holdout
Bounded research search does not certify unlimited live policy
One-week control conserves chips and is not a matched chip strategy
No parameter or model selection from this diagnostic

analysis_revision: Contiguous-week uncertainty and embedded downloads added after execution; sealed decisions and actual outcomes unchanged.
